name: Band Face Pull
steps: Anchor a band near face height, face it holding both ends, and step back until your straight arms hold tension.
Brace your core in a staggered stance with your chest upright.
Pull your hands smoothly toward your temples while spreading your elbows wide and rotating your thumbs slightly backward.
Extend your arms slowly forward to the start without letting the band yank your shoulders.
tips: Keep your shoulders down away from your ears as your hands pass your cheeks.
Finish with your hands beside your ears rather than letting your elbows pull far ahead of your wrists.
